Is this session running under webR?

Source: R/vocab-download.R
omop_is_webr.Rd

Is this session running under webR?

Usage

omop_is_webr()

Value

TRUE when running in a WebAssembly build of R, such as webr or a shinylive application, otherwise FALSE.
